2607.12771.title: Learning Mechanistic Reasoning for Chemical Reactions with Large Language Models
2607.12771.paper_summary: Reaction mechanisms consist of the step-by-step sequences of elementary reactions that explain chemical transformations. Learning the mechanism logic is therefore essential for enhancing the fundamental chemical intelligence of large language models (LLMs). The stepwise deduction of reaction mechanism aligns naturally with the reasoning paradigms of reasoning LLMs. However, current chemical LLMs primarily emphasize coarse-grained name reactions for product prediction and retrosynthesis, often leading to physical inconsistencies and hallucinations. In contrast, specialized small-scale generative models for mechanism inference typically suffer from restricted generalization capacity across diverse chemical spaces. To overcome these limitations, we built a novel, large-scale reasoning dataset of reaction mechanisms. Furthermore, we established the FukuyamaBench, a difficult benchmark derived from Fukuyama's Advanced Organic Reaction Mechanism book, to rigorously evaluate model performance on hierarchical mechanism reasoning. Our fine-tuned Qwen3-30B-A3B achieves 8.3% exact pathway match on FukuyamaBench Set~A, surpassing the specialized FlowER model (5.1%), demonstrating that mechanism-aware training substantially enhances chemical reasoning in language models.
2607.12771.paper_summary_zh: 反應機制由逐步的基本反應序列組成，解釋化學轉化。因此，學習機制邏輯對於增強大型語言模型（LLMs）的基本化學智能至關重要。逐步推導反應機制自然與推理LLMs的推理範式相一致。然而，當前的化學LLMs主要強調粗略的命名反應以進行產品預測和逆合成，這往往導致物理不一致和幻覺。相對而言，專門的小型生成模型在機制推斷方面通常受到跨多樣化化學空間的限制性泛化能力的影響。為了克服這些限制，我們建立了一個新穎的大規模反應機制推理數據集。此外，我們建立了FukuyamaBench，這是一個源自福山的《高級有機反應機制》一書的困難基準，用於嚴格評估模型在分層機制推理上的表現。我們微調的Qwen3-30B-A3B在FukuyamaBench Set~A上達到了8.3%的精確路徑匹配，超過了專門的FlowER模型（5.1%），顯示出機制感知訓練顯著增強了語言模型中的化學推理。
